subject: Pathfinder POC kickoff — startup blockers & jumpstart plan
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Emily Olson <emily.olson@pathfinder.ai>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-20T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pathfinder POC kickoff — post-call recap & next steps

Hi Emily — thanks again for a good discovery call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single mutual action plan: 

Summary from our call
- Goal: Verify latency/throughput and integration path for Pathfinder's feedback ingestion pipeline.
- Success criteria: endpoint latency < 120ms p50 on 4k tokens and 20% cost reduction vs current baseline.
- Constraints: security team requires SOC 2 evidence and a network diagram before any production-level data flows.

Mutual action items and owners
1) Redwood: provide quickstart checklist and temporary dev tokens so your engineers can validate routing and SDK calls (attached). — Irene
2) Pathfinder: spin up a small test job using sample payloads and confirm KV/cache behavior (no PII). — Emily
3) Security: Pathfinder to share specific audit questions so we can prioritize artifacts. — Emily
4) Pairing session: schedule a 45m pairing call for hands-on setup and telemetry review (proposed times below). — All

Attachments: redwood-quickstart-checklist.pdf (quick steps, common pitfalls)

Proposed pairing slots (PT):
- Tue 10/26 10:00–10:45
- Wed 10/27 14:00–14:45
- Thu 10/28 09:00–09:45

If none of those work, tell me a couple of times that do and I’ll have Dev join. If you prefer, we can also provide a short (2-week) dev token so you can run against our hosted inference without a full security sign-off.

Thanks — looking forward to getting Pathfinder running.

Best,
Irene Choi
Account Executive, Redwoo d Inference
---
Redwood Inference | irene.choi@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0134

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Emily Olson <emily.olson@pathfinder.ai>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-27T09:06:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pathfinder POC kickoff — quick check on setup?

Hi Emily — just checking in on the quickstart checklist I sent last week. We haven't seen test traffic come through yet and I wanted to make sure nothing is blocked on our side.

Common blockers we've seen at this stage:
- Temporary token not used / never exchanged for real credentials
- Network egress rules preventing outbound connections to our hosted endpoints
- Missing SDK initialization (KV cache not being warmed)

If any of those ring true, we can do a short pairing session this week. I can have Dev (cc'd) hop on to run through the SDK snippet and inspect telemetry live.

If priority has shifted, please let me know — we can pause the trial or schedule for later.

Thanks,
Irene

From: Emily Olson <emily.olson@pathfinder.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-28T11:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pathfinder POC kickoff — quick check on setup?

Hi Irene — thanks for the follow-up and the checklist. Apologies for the radio silence — we've hit an internal roadblock. Quick status: 

- Our security team paused any outbound connections to third-party inference endpoints until we provide them with SOC 2 artifacts, KMS integration details, and a high-level network diagram.
- Our engineering team tried the SDK but couldn't validate due to the network block.

Can you share SOC 2 scoping info and a brief note on how Redwood handles customer keys (KMS/HSM options)? Also: an example network diagram that shows minimal egress and audit log paths would be very helpful.

If you can provide those items, I can escalate and try to get a quick sign-off. We still want to move forward — just need the security artifacts in place.

Thanks,
Emily Olson
Customer Success Manager, Pathfinder AI
emily.olson@pathfinder.ai

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Emily Olson <emily.olson@pathfinder.ai>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-29T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pathfinder POC kickoff — SOC2 + KMS + immediate jumpstart options

Hi Emily — great, thanks for the clarity. I pulled together the artifacts you asked for and a short jumpstart plan so your security review and engineers can move forward quickly.

What I'm attaching/providing here:
- network-kms-faq.pdf — short answers on KMS/HSM options and example network diagrams (attached).
- redwood-quickstart-checklist.pdf — same checklist with an added "security-friendly" path.
- Temporary dev token (attached as redwood-dev-temp-token.txt) — this token is scoped for sandbox traffic only and expires in 14 days. It lets you validate calls without a full security sign-off.

Jumpstart play (if you want us to run it):
1) Security review: read network-kms-faq.pdf and confirm any additional audit items (we can provide SOC 2 scope and point to our compliance portal).
2) Short pairing session (30–45m): we join your engineers, validate egress rules, show SDK init and KV warming, and confirm telemetry. Dev will provoke a sample job and we’ll watch traces.
3) Trial extension: if you hit the security gating step, we can extend the dev token window by 2 weeks while you complete the review.

Proposed pairing slots (PT):
- Wed 11/03 09:30–10:15
- Thu 11/04 10:00–10:45
- Fri 11/05 13:00–13:45

If any of those work, pick one and I'll send a calendar invite with a short agenda. Otherwise, here's a scheduling link: https://app.redwood.com/schedule/irene/30

Best,
Irene

Attachment stubs: network-kms-faq.pdf (PDF, 46KB), redwood-dev-temp-token.txt (TXT, token expires 2026-11-12)

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: Emily Olson <emily.olson@pathfinder.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-04T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pathfinder POC kickoff — SOC2 + KMS + immediate jumpstart options

Adding a quick note from engineering: I scheduled the pairing session for Thu 11/04 10:00 PT and added a short checklist to the invite. I also provisioned the temporary dev token (scope: sandbox, expires 2026-11-12) and confirmed it allows SDK init + a simple sample job to emit telemetry.

Agenda (15m quick setup + 25m runbook walkthrough):
- Confirm egress rules and least-privilege ports/hosts
- Walk through SDK init and KV cache warm-up snippet
- Run a sample payload and confirm traces/latency in telemetry

If security wants a point of contact for SOC 2 scoping, Marissa (cc) can coordinate the compliance packet.

—Dev
